_doc: Screen-behaviour families: what users expect from a kind of screen, independent of stack. Same shape as edge_cases.json: kind -> [[what, why it gets missed, the test that catches it], ...]. Merged into plan_feature.py's catalogue. Family names never collide with edge_cases.json or edge_cases_infra.json, and no `what` repeats an entry in any catalogue (gather() drops repeats silently). Items already owned by skills/ui-baseline (loading/empty/error states, field validation, double submit, optimistic rollback) and skills/accessibility (focus trap, focus return) are not repeated here. `settings` holds only settings-specific rows and builds on `form` (unsaved edits, conflicting saves), so a pattern with editable settings lists both. `_roles` rows are expanded once per --roles name; `_planned` lists families scripts/data/screen_patterns.json maps names to before they are written.
_roles: Role {role}: sees and can use every control the spec grants it
the screen is only ever opened as an admin
sign in as {role}; assert each granted control is visible and enabled
Role {role}: controls it is not granted are hidden, or disabled with the reason
the button fails on click instead of not being offered
sign in as {role}; assert ungranted controls are absent, or disabled with a reason a screen reader announces
Role {role}: a direct URL or API call to an action it is not granted is refused and changes nothing
hiding the button feels like enforcement
as {role}, request the action's route and API directly; assert 403 or 404 and no state change
settings: A destructive or irreversible setting (delete workspace, revoke keys, disable SSO, downgrade plan) applies on one click
settings are treated as plain form fields
trigger each destructive setting; assert a confirmation naming the resource and the consequence, and Cancel changes nothing
Save is enabled with nothing changed
the save button is wired once and never revisited
load the page; assert Save is disabled until a field differs from the stored value
A partial save failure reports success or a generic error
the backend is tested one field at a time
fail one field server-side; assert that field is named, the others show as saved, and the edits stay on screen
Edits cannot be discarded, or a default cannot be restored
the author never needs to undo
change fields and choose Discard; assert stored values return; Reset restores the documented default
A setting with side effects saves without saying so (signs everyone out, affects all members, needs re-verification)
side effects live in backend code the screen's author never reads
save each side-effect setting; assert the effect is stated before it is saved
Nobody can tell who changed a setting, or when
auditing is treated as a backend concern
change a setting; assert the change, the actor and the time appear in the settings history or audit log
destructive-action: An irreversible action runs on one click with no confirmation naming what is destroyed
the happy path is the author deleting test data
click delete; assert a dialog naming the resource, and Cancel leaves it intact
The confirmation asks 'Are you sure?' and its button says OK
dialog copy is written last, and generically
assert the dialog names the object and what else is lost ("and its 12 comments"), the button repeats the verb ("Delete"), and focus starts on Cancel
A high-impact deletion (workspace, account, production data) needs only one click on the confirmation
one dialog component is reused for every delete
assert the confirm button stays disabled until the resource name is typed exactly
A reversible action is made permanent with no undo
soft delete exists in the database but not on the screen
delete, then assert an Undo toast or a trash with Restore brings the item back
A bulk destructive action hides how many items it affects, or a partial failure
the bulk path reuses the single-item handler
select 3 items with 1 failing server-side; assert the dialog says 3, and the result names the failure and keeps that item
A deleted item still shows in other views (lists, counters, badges, other tabs)
only the current view is refreshed
delete, then assert lists, counters and a second open tab no longer show it
Deleting something another user has open breaks their screen
deletion is tested with one session
user B has the item open while A deletes it; assert B is told it was deleted, not shown an error page or allowed a stale save
form: Input is lost on a server error or an expired session
errors are tested with an empty form
fill the form, force a 500 and then a 401; assert every field keeps its value after the error and after signing back in
An edit form overwrites a newer change made by someone else
records are edited by one person in development
open the edit form, change the record elsewhere, submit; assert a conflict message, not a silent overwrite
After saving, the user cannot tell it worked or where they are
the author watches the network tab
submit; assert a success message and a landing view that shows the saved record
Required and optional fields look the same
the author knows which fields matter
assert required fields are marked and the marking is exposed to assistive technology
A consequential choice (plan, recipient, amount) is pre-selected for the user
defaults are copied from the last test run
open a new form; assert documented defaults are filled and no consequential field is pre-selected
An edit form opens empty or with stale values
the create form is reused for edit
open edit on an existing record; assert every field shows the current stored value
Leaving a half-filled form loses the input without warning
forms are always submitted in testing
fill two fields and navigate away; assert a discard prompt, and Cancel keeps the input
list-table: Sort, filter and page are lost on back, refresh or a shared link
list state lives in component memory
set a sort, a filter and page 2; refresh and go back, then open the URL in a new session; assert the same view each time
'No records yet' and 'no results for these filters' look the same
only the empty database is tested
filter to zero results; assert a no-matches message with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state
A bulk selection hides its scope, or survives the action
selection is tested on one page
select rows across two pages; assert the count is shown, the action applies to all of them, and the selection clears afterwards
Row actions are offered on records the user cannot act on
the list is built while signed in as admin
sign in as a lower role; assert actions it lacks are absent or disabled on every row
The list is stale after a create, edit or delete made elsewhere
each view fetches once
change a record in another tab or a modal; assert the list shows the change without a full reload
Long values break the layout or are cut off with no way to read them
sample data is short
use a 200-character name; assert it truncates and the full value is reachable on hover, focus or the detail view
Export ignores the current filters, or exports only the visible page
export calls the unfiltered endpoint
filter, then export; assert the file holds exactly the filtered rows across all pages
detail-view: A link to a deleted or forbidden record shows a blank page or a generic error
links are only followed to records that exist
open a deleted id and a forbidden id; assert distinct not-found and no-access messages, each with a way back
Back from a record loses the list's scroll position and filters
navigation is tested from the top of an unfiltered list
scroll and filter the list, open a record, go back; assert the same position and filters
A change made elsewhere while the page is open is invisible, then overwritten
the page is viewed by one person at a time
change the record in another session; assert the open page shows or flags the change before any save
One failing related panel blanks the whole page
related data is fetched together with the main record
fail one related request; assert the rest of the page renders and that panel shows its own error
Actions ignore the record's state (edit an archived record, pay a paid order)
the page is built for the record's normal state
open a record in each terminal state; assert unavailable actions are absent or disabled with the reason
The URL and page title do not identify the record
the page is reached by clicking, never by a shared link
assert the URL is stable and shareable and the title names the record
auth-screens: Password managers cannot fill or save the credentials
assert the inputs carry autocomplete="username", "current-password" or "new-password" as appropriate
The password cannot be revealed before submitting
masking is the default and nobody questions it
assert a show-password control toggles the field and works from the keyboard
After signing in the user lands on home, not the page they asked for
sign-in is tested from the home page
open a protected deep link signed out, then sign in; assert arrival at that page, and only for same-origin targets
The session expires mid-task and the work is lost
expire the session with a form half filled; assert re-authentication returns to the form with its input intact
An expired or already-used reset or verification link is a dead end
open an expired and a used link; assert a clear message and a one-step way to request a new one
A one-time code screen has no paste, no resend and no attempts left
codes are read from the console in development
assert pasting fills every digit, resend appears after a stated wait, and a wrong code says how many tries remain
scheduling: Times show in the server's or the author's time zone, not the viewer's
the whole team shares one time zone
view one booking as users in two zones; assert each sees local time with the zone named
A recurring slot across a daylight-saving change shifts by an hour
test dates avoid March and November
book a weekly slot spanning a DST change; assert the wall-clock time stays the same
Two people book the same slot
booking is tested by one user
submit the same slot from two sessions; assert one succeeds and the other is told it was taken and offered alternatives
Past times or closed hours can be picked
the date picker allows any date
assert past slots and closed hours cannot be selected and are rejected server-side
Rescheduling or cancelling skips the confirmation or the cancellation policy
only creating a booking is designed
reschedule and cancel inside the policy window; assert the consequence (fee, lost slot) is stated before confirming
Reminders still go out for a cancelled or moved appointment
reminders are scheduled at creation and never revisited
cancel one booking and move another; assert the old reminders are not sent and the moved one gets a new reminder
One occurrence of a recurring event cannot be changed on its own
recurrence is stored as a single row
edit one occurrence; assert the choice of this event, this and following, or all, and only the chosen ones change
checkout: The total on the review screen differs from the amount charged
totals are computed separately on client and server
change the cart, then compare the review total with the charged amount; assert they are equal to the cent
A price, stock or coupon change between cart and payment is applied silently
catalogue data is static in development
change the price and stock after adding to cart; assert the review screen flags each change before payment
Place order shows no progress, so a slow payment invites a second click or an abandoned order
payment responds instantly in development
throttle the payment call; assert Place order disables with progress, and retrying after a timeout shows the existing order instead of creating a second
A declined payment loses the cart or the entered address
only the success path is designed
decline the card; assert the cart and address remain and the message says what to do next
The order confirmation has no order number, summary or next step
the confirmation is designed as a thank-you page
assert the confirmation shows the order number, items, total, delivery estimate and that a receipt was sent
Coupon errors are generic, or a removed coupon keeps its discount
coupons are tested with one valid code
apply an expired code, a below-minimum code and a valid code, then remove it; assert a specific message each time and the total returning
Abandoning a bank redirect (3-D Secure) leaves the order in an unknown state
the redirect always returns in testing
abandon the redirect; assert the order shows pending or failed and payment can be retried without a duplicate order
money-transfer: Recipient, amount and fee are not shown together before sending
the review step is skipped for speed
assert a review step shows recipient name, account hint, amount, fee and total, and nothing is sent before Confirm
Send fires twice on a double tap or a retry
transfers are tested one tap at a time
double-tap Send and retry after a simulated timeout; assert exactly one transfer
Balance and daily limits are only checked after confirming
limits are a backend rule
enter an amount over the balance and one over the limit; assert the screen blocks each before review and shows the limit
Amounts are parsed or shown with the wrong decimal separator or currency
the team uses one locale
enter 1.000,50 in a comma-decimal locale; assert the parsed amount and display match the locale and currency
A pending or failed transfer looks completed
status comes from the request, not the ledger
simulate pending, then failed; assert each status is shown and a failed transfer says whether money left the account
No receipt or reference is shown after sending
success is shown as a toast
assert a receipt with reference, time, amount and recipient, still available later in the history
A new payee or a large amount needs no extra verification
step-up checks are left to the backend
add a new payee and send above the threshold; assert the step-up the spec names (one-time code, cooling-off period) is required
